note: One composer per idea. Change the composer when the idea changes; never repeat the same one for two consecutive beats.

composers.open: Empty project: an empty preview frame and empty timeline, then content pours in. Use for the hook.
composers.chatLink: OR on the left, the installed harness outside a dashed boundary on the right, tokens crossing and returning. Use when explaining that OR is a client of an external assistant, not an agent of its own.
composers.chatRun: Chat conversation with tool steps and a permission card, then a script file appears. Use for idea → script.
composers.assembly: Shapes fly in and assemble into a composition, then the whole frame shrinks into a timeline clip. Use for code/JSON → MotionScene → clip.
composers.motionDetail: A scene sheet with growing bars, an orbiting shape and a still preview card. Use for deterministic scenes, preview-before-render, PNG assets.
composers.motionLibrary: Thumbnail grid, one card lifts, duplicates and exposes parameter chips. Use for reusable scene templates.
composers.voiceGen: Script lines on the left, a local speech server chip, a waveform growing, a clip landing on the audio lane. Use for TTS.
composers.voiceChoose: Three voice sources with selection ring and cost/key chips. Use for local vs system vs cloud voice, honestly priced.
composers.whisperListen: Big waveform, sweeping playhead, words popping out, caption chips appearing below. Use for local transcription.
composers.captionSync: Preview frame with subtitles appearing in time, caption lane underneath, style panel sliding in. Use for caption review and styling.
composers.editOps: Zoomed timeline: drag, trim, split, ripple. Use for the basic editing verbs.
composers.previewSync: Timeline on the left, preview on the right with a before/after wipe and a shared playhead. Use for 'you see the result immediately'.
composers.layers: Video, audio and caption planes separate, then snap into the frame; music dips under voice. Use for layer thinking and ducking.
composers.automation: One chat request fans out into tool chips that fly into tracks and fill them. Use for assistant-driven batch work.
composers.localDevice: A device outline with engines inside and a crossed cloud outside. Use for local-first processing.
composers.freeLicence: Licence badges (MIT, VieNeu, Whisper) and an honest cost note. Use for free/open claims; never imply paid services become free.
composers.platforms: Per-platform capability bars with a fallback note. Use for hardware/OS and performance expectations.
composers.finale: All layers converge into the preview, export bar fills, completion tick. Use for the finished product.
composers.close: Workflow map lighting up in order. Use for the takeaway.
